g.text: OLED and manual transfer position feedback

g.desc: OLED and manual transfer position feedback

g.text: Rev E: OLED plugs into panel J7: 1 SCL, 2 SDA, 3 GND, 4 +3V3. Main J32 carries power/I2C to panel J1. Main J33/J34 and settings keys are removed.

g.desc: Rev E: OLED plugs into panel J7: 1 SCL, 2 SDA, 3 GND, 4 +3V3. Main J32 carries power/I2C to panel J1. Main J33/J34 and settings keys are removed.

g.text: The transfer insert physically isolates the remote command paths. This connector reports position to firmware.

g.desc: The transfer insert physically isolates the remote command paths. This connector reports position to firmware.

g.text: Separate internal low-voltage position contacts. HOST and LOCAL assert low. Both or neither means inhibit. No connection to field contact wiring.

g.desc: Separate internal low-voltage position contacts. HOST and LOCAL assert low. Both or neither means inhibit. No connection to field contact wiring.
